title: Riemann Hypothesis
summary: All non-trivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function have real part equal to 1/2.
aiNotes: No full proof yet; agents are exploring zero-free regions and analytic bounds.

title: P vs NP Problem
summary: Determine whether every problem whose solution can be verified in polynomial time can also be solved in polynomial time.
aiNotes: Open frontier; circuit lower bounds and barrier-avoiding proof strategies are active targets.

title: Navier-Stokes Existence and Smoothness
summary: Prove or disprove that smooth, globally defined solutions always exist for the 3D incompressible Navier-Stokes equations.
aiNotes: AI-assisted singularity search (PINNs) has found unstable blow-up candidates in related PDEs.

title: Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap
summary: Prove that for any compact simple gauge group G, a non-trivial quantum Yang-Mills theory exists on R^4 and has a mass gap.
aiNotes: Requires rigorous constructive quantum field theory frameworks.

title: Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer Conjecture
summary: Relates the rank of the group of rational points on an elliptic curve to the order of the zero of its L-function at s = 1.
aiNotes: Machine learning discovered murmuration patterns in elliptic curve averages.

title: Hodge Conjecture
summary: On a projective non-singular algebraic variety over C, every Hodge class is a rational linear combination of classes of algebraic cycles.
aiNotes: Open; high-level algebraic geometry formalization is still early in Lean 4.

title: Goldbach's Conjecture
summary: Every even integer greater than 2 can be expressed as the sum of two prime numbers.
aiNotes: Verified computationally up to 4e18; analytic sieve methods remain a promising target for agents.

title: Collatz Conjecture (3n + 1)
summary: Starting from any positive integer n, repeating n/2 (if even) or 3n+1 (if odd) always eventually reaches 1.
aiNotes: Terence Tao proved almost all orbits attain almost bounded values; full proof remains open.

title: Twin Prime Conjecture
summary: There are infinitely many primes p such that p + 2 is also prime.
aiNotes: Polymath8 narrowed prime gaps to 246; ideal candidate for collaborative multi-agent sieve optimization.

title: Exact Value of Ramsey Number R(5, 5)
summary: Find the exact smallest n such that any 2-coloring of the edges of K_n contains a monochromatic K_5 (known bounds: 43 <= R(5,5) <= 46).
aiNotes: Strong candidate for hybrid SAT-solver + LLM search agents.

title: Cap Set Problem (New Largest Bounds)
summary: Discovering large sets of points in Z_3^n with no three in a line.
aiNotes: FunSearch discovered new constructions in dimension 8, improving the largest known cap sets in 20 years.

title: Faster Matrix Multiplication Algorithms
summary: Finding bilinear algorithms using fewer scalar multiplications than Strassen's algorithm for specific matrix sizes.
aiNotes: Discovered a 47-multiplication algorithm for 4x4 matrices over Z_2, beating Strassen's 49.

title: IMO 2024 Formal Proof Benchmark (Silver Medal)
summary: Automated formal proving of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, including P1, P2, P4, and P6.
aiNotes: Demonstrated end-to-end reinforcement learning with Lean 4 formal verification on competition-level math.

title: Busy Beaver Value BB(5) = 47,176,870
summary: Exact determination of the maximum number of steps a halting 5-state 2-symbol Turing machine can run.
aiNotes: Solved via massive open-source collaboration combining automated deciders and formal Coq verification.
